results.title: HTTP security headers
results.summary: All 5 expected security headers are present.

evidence.response: HTTP 200 | present: Content-Security-Policy, Strict-Transport-Security, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy

results.remediation: No action needed - helmet is already applying these headers. Keep them enabled.

results.title: Session cookie flags
results.summary: Session cookie is HttpOnly, Secure and SameSite=Strict.

evidence.response: HTTP 200 | Set-Cookie flags: HttpOnly=true Secure=true SameSite=Strict=true

results.remediation: No action needed. Note that Secure means plain http:// will not keep a session - always use https://.

results.title: Protected endpoints reject anonymous callers
results.summary: All 7 protected endpoints returned 401 without a session.
results.remediation: No action needed - every tested endpoint requires a verified MFA session.

results.title: A bank session cannot read the school app (and vice versa)
results.summary: Each session only reaches its own application. Cross-app reads are rejected with 401.
results.remediation: No action needed - requireApp()/requireAcadiaRole() correctly pin the session to one application.

results.title: A student cannot reach administrator functions
results.summary: All 6 administrator endpoints rejected the student session (401/403).

evidence.response: HTTP 403 {"error":"Access denied for this account role"}
HTTP 403 {"error":"Access denied for this account role"}
HTTP 403 {"error":"Access denied for this account role"}
HTTP 403 {"error":"Access denied for this account role"}
HTTP 403 {"error":"Access denied for this account role"}
HTTP 403 {"error":"Access denied for this account role"}

results.remediation: No action needed - requireAcadiaRole('admin') is enforced on every administrator route.

results.title: Any bank user can read every student's name and tuition balance
results.summary: 6 student record(s) - names and outstanding tuition - were disclosed to a bank account with no relationship to them.
results.remediation: The lookup must be scoped to students the caller has a legitimate relationship with. Instead of a bare sequential ID, require a payer/student link (for example a row in a payments or tuition-link table for req.session.userId) and return 404 when no link exists. Replace the sequential AC######## identifier with an unguessable reference, and rate-limit enumeration.

results.title: MFA guessing is only weakly rate-limited
results.summary: Three wrong codes triggered a lock (HTTP 429), but it released after about 31s and the counter is not persistent. At that rate about 2.5% of the 1,000,000-code space can be covered per day.

evidence.response: HTTP 401 {"error":"Invalid, expired, or already used code"}
HTTP 401 {"error":"Invalid, expired, or already used code"}
HTTP 429 {"error":"Too many attempts. Sign in again later."}

results.remediation: Track MFA failures in the database against the user (not the session), apply exponential backoff that persists across sessions, lock after a small number of failures until an administrator or out-of-band step clears it, and alert on repeated MFA failures. Consider accepting only the current time step rather than a +/-1 window.

results.title: Login does not reveal whether an account exists
results.summary: Existing and non-existing usernames both returned HTTP 401 with an identical body.
results.remediation: Keep the identical generic message. Also consider equalising response time, because argon2 verification runs only when the user exists.

results.title: Session identifier rotates on authentication
results.summary: A client-chosen identifier was rejected, and the session id was reissued when the session became authenticated.

evidence.response: HTTP 200 | sid reissued after authentication: true

results.remediation: No action needed - identifiers are HMAC-signed so a chosen id is rejected, and session.regenerate() is called at login.

results.title: Public registration cannot create an administrator
results.summary: Registration accepted a role:"admin" field but the account was still just a student: /api/school/enrollments returned 200 while /api/school/admin/students returned 403.

evidence.response: HTTP 403 {"error":"Access denied for this account role"}

results.remediation: No action needed - the handler destructures only app/username/password and assigns the role server-side. Delete the probe account after testing.

results.title: Authentication endpoints are rate limited
results.remediation: No action needed at this level. Note the limiter is per IP address and in-memory, so it resets on restart and does not follow an account across IPs.

results.title: Plain HTTP is not redirected to HTTPS
results.summary: Plain HTTP returned HTTP 200 with no redirect. Because the session cookie is Secure, a browser on http:// silently loses its session after login.
results.remediation: Add an HTTP listener that answers with a 308 redirect to the HTTPS host, or enforce HTTPS at the edge (Tailscale Funnel already terminates TLS, so redirect inside Caddy). Users should always be given the https:// URL.
